scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @app/server" "npm run dev -w @app/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run build -w @app/server && npm run build -w @app/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run typecheck -w @app/server && npm run typecheck -w @app/client
